reason: This plugin is a local color utility for DeepSeek Harness, centered on parsing/format-conversion, WCAG contrast evaluation, and named-color lookup, as shown by its README tool list and usage examples; risk is low because the described behavior is deterministic math operations with no declared external integrations or side effects.

summaries.zh: dsh-color 是一个为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的本地颜色工具插件，支持解析并转换多种 CSS 颜色格式、计算对比度并查找颜色名称。
summaries.en: dsh-color is a local DeepSeek Harness plugin that parses and converts CSS colors, computes contrast ratios, and looks up named colors.

capabilities: Parse and convert CSS color values across hex, rgb, hsl, and hwb formats.
Compute WCAG contrast ratios and AA/AAA verdicts for normal/large text.
Lookup CSS named colors by partial name or exact value.
